correctness.rationale: The body is normalized affinely to the simplex (0,0),(1,0),(0,1). For normals (1,t), the centroid of a triangular cap yields C1(r)=(1-(r+q/r)/3,r/3) for sqrt(q)<=r<=1, and the complement triangle yields C2(r)=((1-p²/r)/(3q),(1-pr)/(3q)) for r decreasing 1 to sqrt(p). Cap switch t=p and all six ordered-normal sectors cover the circle. The first arc obeys lambda0*lambda2=q/9 and the second (1-3qx)(1-3qy)=p^3; Green integration gives J1=(p+q log q)/9 and J2=p²(q+p log p)/(9q²), hence F=6(J1+J2). Independent direct quadrature of both arc integrands agreed at six levels, including tiny q and q=1/2; series expansion gave F(q)=1+(2/3)q log q-(11/9)q+q²/6+O(q³). The complement scaling follows the general first moment identity q(Cq-G)+p(Cp(-u)-G)=0, already known. The algorithmic cap-clipping verifier checks other numerical levels but does not replace exact integration.
